{{Short description|French cross-country skier (born 1977)}} {{Infobox skier | name = Alexandre Rousselet | image = | image_size = | alt = | caption = | nationality = {{FRA}} | full_name = | birth_name = | birth_date = {{birth date and age|1977|01|29|df=y}} | birth_place = [[Pontarlier]], France | death_date = | death_place = | height = | club = Emhm Métabief | personalbest = | spouse = | seasons =10 – ([[2000–01 FIS Cross-Country World Cup|2001]]–[[2009–10 FIS Cross-Country World Cup|2010]]) | wins = | teamwins = 1 | totalpodiums = 0 | teampodiums = 4 | individual_starts = 110 | team_starts = 21 | wcoveralls = 0 – (33rd in [[2005–06 FIS Cross-Country World Cup|2006]]) | wctitles = 0 }} '''Alexandre Rousselet''' (born 29 January 1977) is a French [[cross-country skiing (sport)|cross-country skier]] who has competed since 1998. His best individual finish at the [[Winter Olympics]] was 19th in the 15 km event at [[Turin]] in [[2006 Winter Olympics|2006]]. Rousselet's best finish at the [[FIS Nordic World Ski Championships]] was fifth in the 4 × 10 km relay at [[Sapporo]] in [[FIS Nordic World Ski Championships 2007|2007]] while his best individual finish was 25th in the 15 km event in [[FIS Nordic World Ski Championships 2005|2005]]. His best individual career finish was fourth in a 15 km + 15 km double pursuit FIS race in [[France]] in 2006 while his best individual World Cup finish was eighth in a 30 km event in [[Italy]], also in 2006.
